Commands & shortcuts

The command picker is the quickest way to discover an action. Press ⌘K, type part of a command name, and press Return. The picker also exposes appearance, Ghostty import, background image, and remote-host actions.

Keyboard shortcuts

ActionShortcut
Command picker⌘K
New tab⌘T
Close focused pane⌘W
Close tab⌥⌘W
New session⇧⌘N
Go to directory⇧⌘G
Refresh sessions⌘R
Split pane right⌘D
Split pane down⇧⌘D
Zoom or unzoom pane⇧⌘↩
Next pane⌘]
Previous pane⌘[
Select tab 1–9⌘1–⌘9
Cycle appearance⇧⌘A

Command picker actions

You can change or rename a session, rename a tab, add a remote host, create sessions and tabs, open a directory in a new local tab, close a tab or session, refresh sessions, choose Follow System / Light / Dark, import or clear Ghostty settings, set and toggle a dithered background image, split panes, and toggle pane zoom.

Input focus

Keyboard input goes to the focused terminal pane when no picker or editor is open. Click inside a pane to focus it. The Rust daemon receives terminal input and owns the PTY process; the Swift app does not launch a second process for a pane.
